spec_match.rationale: Implements the explainer's own e-commerce example: real uareplacestart/uareplaceend listeners on the product image hide/restore the zoom control and model-dimension caption, plus the catch-up replacedByUserAgent read at load.

interactive.rationale: Zoom toggle, synthetic start/end dispatch, live adaptation of the card, and an analytics feed with counts and replaced-state duration all respond to real interactions.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises the explainer scenario with labelled synthetic dispatch and the analytics composition; the page delivers both.

edge_cases.rationale: Catch-up read reports the honest undefined/absent state, the sim banner plus isTrusted:false readout keeps synthetic dispatch clearly distinct from a real UA replacement, and the stand-in render is watermarked as simulation in both pixels and alt text.

references.rationale: See-also links the explainer example section and the chromestatus.com/feature/5076374013476864 entry.

conformance.rationale: The feature-level suite covers the exact members this page relies on and records the real-replacement flow as a manual assertion; the shared support panel renders on the page with honest 1 pass / 5 fail / 2 blocked in this build.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless CDP harness drove zoom, start, and end: verified replaced class, hidden zoom control, hidden caption, visible badge and sim banner, feed rows, counters, and a non-zero replaced-duration metric; before/replaced/after and mobile screenshots read and judged; zero console errors.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts adaptation-on-start, restore-on-end, and the catch-up read shape, with isTrusted recorded so synthetic runs are distinguishable in telemetry.

design_system.rationale: All colours are CSS variables; the aria-pressed button state swaps background and color together; the badge uses text-black on ivory inversion.

accessibility.rationale: Zoom toggle exposes aria-pressed and aria-controls, adaptation state is announced through a role=status live region, the stand-in swap updates alt text, and the feed list carries an aria-label.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Dedicated 360x740 DPR3 run mid-replacement measured 0px horizontal overflow with stacked panels and full-width 44px+ controls; desktop 1280 verified through the interaction harness screenshots.

openQuestions.title: Exercise the page against a real UA-initiated replacement when a capable build ships
openQuestions.detail: The adaptation code paths are driven by the real event names but have only been fired synthetically (isTrusted: false). Once a Chrome build with an actual replacement feature (e.g. try-on) plus UAImageReplacementAPI is available, verify a real replacement drives the same listeners with isTrusted: true and that the catch-up read returns true while substitute content shows.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region event log updates without overwhelming screen readers
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce state transitions through a single polite status region; keep repeated log rows out of live regions; maintain accessible names as content changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: One role=status line announces each adaptation change; the analytics feed is a labelled non-live list; the hero image's alt is rewritten when the labelled stand-in render is swapped in.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive product card and control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grid tracks with minmax(0,...) so panels can shrink; images max-width 100%; wrap long mono output.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: 5fr/4fr grid collapses to one column at 820px, product image is width:100% height:auto, statusline and feed use overflow-wrap anywhere; measured 0px overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: analytics event feed for replacement start end tracking
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep analytics events small, timestamped, and aggregated rather than one beacon per interaction.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The demo aggregates counts and replaced-state duration locally and shows timestamped feed rows; no network beacons are sent from the demo, so batching applies as the illustrated pattern in the snippet.

summary: Try-On Storefront wires the explainer's e-commerce example to the real event names and layers the explainer's analytics motivation on top. CDP verification confirmed the full adapt/restore cycle, honest catch-up read, isTrusted labelling, watermarked stand-in render, and clean console on desktop and a 0-overflow mobile run.
